fact: Instruction n°58 of 4 September 2024 provides for interoperability of the platforms of banks, microfinance institutions, fintechs and e-money institutions and their connection to the national switch Mosolo, and the CEGFT still asks that transfers between mobile money operators be made simple.
title: RDC : le CEGFT propose six mesures pour accompagner la BCC sur l’interopérabilité
